boundaries.rationale: no container, Kubernetes or IaC boundary covers these processes; the repository itself is used as the trust boundary
boundaries.name: repository: fastapi-full-stack

threat_agents.rationale: each of the 1 outbound dependencies is a potentially hostile responder
threat_agents.name: Compromised external service

threat_agents.rationale: one insider agent per trust boundary, placed inside it
threat_agents.name: Insider with access to repository: fastapi-full-stack

threat_agents.rationale: these entry points are not published outside the deployment; a caller must already be inside it
threat_agents.name: Workload inside the deployment calling HTTP client endpoints
